Name: Ptolomea
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: Ptolomea are mindless soldiers ruled by greater fiends, with almost no sense of autonomy. They take to greater demons readily, falling under the sway of higher powers (unless they decide to rebel against them first). Ptolomea are so vast in number that they can make up entire armies, marching across landscapes they freeze and reducing everything to blood and ice. Due to their perpetually freezing bodies they are drawn to warm blood, and fly into a frenzy if they sense it being drawn from a creature - a frenzy that propels them to slay and consume it.

traits.name: Frost Death
traits.description:
When the demon is reduced to 0 hit points, its body erupts into ice that fills the space it’s in and spills out into all adjacent spaces. These spaces become difficult terrain. Creatures in these spaces when this occurs must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they are caught in the ice and are restrained. A creature restrained this way can attempt a DC 13 Strength check as an action, breaking free on a success.

Each space the ice fills has 5 hit points, 12 AC, resistance to piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning damage, and is vulnerable to fire damage. Ice in a space is destroyed if reduced to 0 hit points or takes fire damage. The central space where the demon was becomes a large ice spike that no creature can move through.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The demon makes two attacks with its Freezing Scythe.

actions.name: Freezing Scythe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., cleaving, one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage plus 4 (1d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Freezing Breath (1/Rest)
actions.description: The demon breathes a 15-foot-cone of frost originating from it. All creatures in the cone must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 13 (2d8 + 4) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who fails is also partially frozen, and on their next turn they are sluggish.

bonus_actions.name: Warm Blood Frenzy
bonus_actions.description: If the demon is aware of a creature that has half of its maximum hit points remaining or less, it can take the Dash action (using the movement to move as close to it as it can) and makes an attack against it using its Freezing Scythe. If it moves more than 10 feet to get to its target it makes this attack with advantage.
